dem.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (European Space Agency / AWS Open Data)
dem.coverage: 100.0% coverage of study domain [76.75, 9.75, 77.08, 10.08] (1,321.35 km²). Covers Idukki Arch Dam, Cheruthoni, Kulamavu, full reservoir basin, and ~46 km downstream Periyar gorge towards Neriamangalam.
dem.notes: Authentic Copernicus DEM GLO-30 4-tile mosaic clipped to exact study boundary with zero missing or zero-fill pixels. Unmodified source tiles preserved in source directory.

river.coverage: Full Periyar river network. Main stem forms 81.25 km downstream channel flowing northwest through gorge to Neriamangalam (~46.3 km straight-line distance).
river.notes: Classified vector geometry. Determines downstream hydraulic flow path based on genuine topography and natural drainage.

buildings.source: OpenStreetMap Building Footprints via Overpass API
buildings.coverage: Building footprints in downstream settlement corridor (Cheruthoni, Painavu, Karimban)
buildings.notes: Genuine building polygon geometries extracted from OSM. No synthetic building grid.

roads.source: OpenStreetMap Road Network via Overpass API
roads.coverage: Arterial, trunk, primary, secondary, and tertiary road network connecting Idukki downstream settlements
roads.notes: Genuine road infrastructure lines extracted from OSM. No artificial road grid.

reservoir.source: OpenStreetMap Natural Water & Reservoir via Overpass API
reservoir.coverage: Idukki Reservoir and Cheruthoni waterbody polygons
reservoir.notes: Genuine reservoir waterbody boundaries extracted from OSM.

boundary.notes: Preliminary study area boundary enclosing Idukki Dam, Cheruthoni, Kulamavu, reservoir, and downstream Periyar gorge towards Neriamangalam.

population.notes: High-resolution population raster not ingested in Phase 3. Synthetic population fallback strictly prohibited by project integrity rules.

satellite.notes: Satellite flood extent rasters not ingested in Phase 3. Synthetic flood polygons or fake IoU/F1 scores strictly prohibited; reserved for subsequent hydrodynamic validation phase.
